description:
Project: website — Garage de mécanique

Business: M360, un garage mécanique

Goal: Permettre aux clients de prendre rendez-vous en ligne et voir les services

Target audience: Propriétaires de véhicules cherchant des services mécaniques

Key features:
- Prise de rendez-vous en ligne (sans paiement)
- Affichage des taux et services
- Galerie photo du garage
- Affichage de l'horaire de la journée bien en vue

Design & brand:
- Colors: Bleu et vert fluo
- Mood: Moderne, punchy et dynamique
- Signature: Un service rapide et transparent
- First impression: L'horaire de la journée, utilise le logo existant

Integrations & extras:
- Calendrier pour la prise de rendez-vous
- Google Maps avec directions pour localisation

designManifest.copyVoice: Clipped pit-crew radio: short imperative sentences, numbers stated proudly, no filler, no exclamation marks; French leads and English mirrors it in equal weight.
designManifest.heroThesis: The homepage opens on the thesis line 'Diagnostic honnête. Service rapide.' beside the garage's own bay, with the rates timing-sheet and the next open slot already visible above the fold — the most characteristic promise of a transparent shop.
designManifest.iconDirection: Rounded square in #0A0E1A with the M360 wordmark centered and a single 2px fluo-green horizontal speed line clipping through the '0', reading as a timing beacon even at 48px.
designManifest.signatureMove: A sticky top status rail on every page rendered like a race timing tower: live OUVERT/FERMÉ pill in fluo green, today's date and hours in mono, and the computed next available appointment slot — recalculated per day of week from the real business-hours table and booked appointments.
designManifest.summary: M360 is presented like a race team's pit wall — a persistent status rail shows today's hours, an OUVERT/FERMÉ beacon and the next open bay the second you land, and every number on the site reads as live instrumentation, arguing that a fast garage has nothing to hide.
designManifest.typography: Space Grotesk (600/700, tight tracking) for display and section heads; Inter (400/500) for body; JetBrains Mono for every number — hours, rates, dates, slots, references — so data reads as telemetry.

promptHistory.changeNotes:
Admin enrichment: (1) Rebuilt public/js/admin.js with French field labels, live search, status filter chips with counts, richer table cells (image thumbnails, boolean/status/price/day badges), toast notifications replacing alerts, inline required-field validation, image upload/AI-generate loading states + live preview, and Escape-to-close on modals — all module pages (RDV, services, galerie, actualités) keep full create/edit/delete CRUD. (2) Redesigned admin dashboard (views/admin.ejs) with a top bar, highlighted pending-RDV card, French status labels, section headers and a 'Gestion rapide' card grid linking every module. (3) Added two new admin pages: admin/settings (functional business info, contact, Google-Maps address, booking slot duration + SEO description — all affect app behavior) and admin/messages (contact-form inbox), plus their routes and sidebar links. (4) Enhanced admin-styles.css: topbar, quick cards, search/filter chips, table hover, thumbnails, cell badges, toast system, focus-visible states, settings form and message-card styling. (5) admin-hours page now shows clearer save feedback. (6) Added focus-visible accessibility outlines to public styles.css. No functional routes/data flows removed; all image placeholder tokens preserved; contrast fallbacks (green bg + dark ink) kept on CTAs.

Fixed the /admin redirect loop by pointing pageAdmin at the site root (there is no /admin/login route) and removed the now-redundant duplicate admin check inside the /admin handler. Hardened mobile layout: status rail no longer wraps under the sticky nav (nowrap + horizontal scroll, FR/EN toggle hidden on mobile since it's still in the footer), added dark color-scheme for native date/time pickers, added hover affordances to rate rows/nav CTA and bumped slot button font size. Removed the dead Déconnexion link from the admin sidebar, added page-specific document titles via existing translation keys, de-duplicated the homepage's closing CTA heading to use booking_title instead of repeating hero_title, and added a mono date stamp to article pages using the existing t.months localization array.
